repro: Run `bun test --config=bunfig.integration.toml --timeout=30000 evidence/takeover-diverged.test.ts` from the repo root. Setup: the story reaches review; the remote branch is reset to boundary~1 (a crash after a boundary the branch lacks); a person pushes a commit onto the branch; the claim expires; clone B runs `norn story checkout`. Expected: B's worktree holds a merge of the heads-ref boundary and the person's commit. Observed under both record policies: B's HEAD is the person's commit with one parent, and the boundary is missing. Under remote policy the state says review while the implement.done commit is absent. Cause: packages/cli/src/runtime/checkout.ts:295 `aheadOf` uses the heads ref only when it is strictly ahead of the branch.
